subject: 68cc04ec9e8dfa8163c0c559
question: A water-purification unit uses a germicidal UV-C lamp that emits electromagnetic radiation of wavelength $\lambda_0=254\,\text{nm}$ in air. The radiation enters water (treated as a non-magnetic dielectric) of refractive index $n=1.33$. Assuming $n$ is constant and taking $c=3.0\times10^8\,\text{m/s}$, determine (i) the wavelength $\lambda_w$ in water, (ii) the time taken to travel a distance $L=0.50\,\text{m}$ in water, and (iii) the number of complete oscillations $N$ of the electric field during this travel.
